Validate a GnRHcell multi-dataset collection

Source: R/collection.R
validate_gnrh_collection.Rd

Performs cross-dataset validation of GnRH detection and developmental staging results generated by run_gnrh_collection.

Usage

validate_gnrh_collection(
  collection,
  output_dir = file.path(collection$output_dir, "validation"),
  positive_classes = c("direct", "supported", "dropout_rescue"),
  validation_markers = NULL,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data",
  write_output = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

collection

An object of class "gnrh_collection" returned by run_gnrh_collection.

output_dir

Optional directory in which validation tables are written. Default is file.path(collection$output_dir, "validation").

positive_classes

Character vector defining positive GnRH detection classes. Default is c("direct", "supported", "dropout_rescue").

validation_markers

Character vector of genes used for independent biological marker validation. If NULL, a predefined marker panel covering GnRH identity, migration, and neuroendocrine maturation is used.

assay

Assay used for biological marker expression summaries. Default is "RNA".

layer

Expression layer used for biological marker expression summaries. Default is "data".

write_output

Logical. Whether validation tables should be written to disk. Default is TRUE.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress messages. Default is TRUE.

Value

An object of class "gnrh_validation" containing:

datasets

Dataset metadata used for validation.

input_summary

Number of cells and features per dataset.

detection

GnRH detection summary.

status_class

Consistency between detection status and class.

scores

Summary of GnRH evidence and staging scores by detection class.

stages

Developmental-stage distribution among GnRH-positive cells.

stage_class

Developmental-stage distribution within each GnRH detection class.

stage_refinement

Summary of raw-to-final stage refinement.

stage_reassignment

Detailed raw-to-final stage transitions.

migration_core

Migration-core evidence by raw stage.

biological_markers

Expression of selected biological validation markers by GnRH detection class.

output_dir

Validation output directory, or NULL.

Details

The function summarizes GnRH detection classes, consistency between detection status and class, evidence scores, developmental stages, stage refinement, migration-specific evidence, and selected biological marker expression across datasets.

Processed Seurat objects must be present in the collection object. Therefore, run_gnrh_collection() should normally be called with clean_objects = FALSE before running this function.

See also

run_gnrh_collection, run_gnrh_dataset, stage_gnrh

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
results <- run_gnrh_collection(
  datasets = datasets,
  output_dir = "gnrh_results",
  clean_objects = FALSE
)

validation <- validate_gnrh_collection(
  results
)

validation$detection
validation$stage_refinement
validation$migration_core
} # }
